---

1.  Clone the repo

    ``` bash
    git clone <github.com/repo>
    cd <repo>
    ```

2.  Checkout to your Branch

    ``` bash
    git checkout <branch_name>
    ```

3.  Create & activate a venv

    ``` bash
    python3 -m venv ./.quarto-venv
    source ./.quarto-venv/bin/activate
    ```

4.  Install dependencies

    ``` bash
    # (with your venv activated)
    pip install --upgrade pip
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    ```

5.  Preview or render your site

    ``` bash
    # (with your venv activated)
    quarto preview index.qmd
    ```

6.  (if necessary) re-generate a `requirements.txt`

    ``` bash
    # Whenever you add or update a Python package, run:
    # (with your venv activated)
    pip install <new_package>
    pip freeze > requirements.txt
    ```
    
7.  build project

    ``` bash
    # (with your venv activated)
    # 1. delete the output folder and render everything
    quarto render --clean
    
    # 2. ignore any cache so all code chunks re-execute
    quarto render . --no-cache
    ```
